why: The striped bar turns 45 degrees clockwise at each step: slanting down, standing up, slanting up, lying flat, slanting down again. So the missing second figure stands upright (vertical). Among the upright options, option 2 has the dark black end mark on the top-left like the bar ends in the series; options 1 and 3 have a white (empty) oval.
trick: Find the turning step from the figures you have, then go back to fill the gap.
note: The small black/white mark at the end of the bar is tiny in the scan; options 2 and 3 differ only by its colour.
